_comment: Input workbook schema. 'sheet' = worksheet name; 'columns' maps each internal field (KEY) to the actual header in your spreadsheet (VALUE). To use a differently-labelled xlsx, change the VALUES to your headers and keep the KEYS. Current = identity (MP 'REFERENCE CATALOGO').

paths._comment: Input file + folder roots, relative to the project ROOT (the parent of catalog_v2). For the Python build only; the browser tools locate inputs by content via the scanner.
